answer: An answer must include the first 18 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Because the velvet derivation is checked against the basalt nonce, the gale audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 27 aliases produces 27 mismatches and burns the authoring cost with no payout. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
